insights.one_liner: AOC is the Amsterdam-based European arm of a computer monitor brand founded in 1967, owned by TPV Technology, and an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Makes computer monitors for offices, home users and gamers (AOC Gaming and AGON), with 55 employees listed on LinkedIn in Amsterdam.
Staff often come from University of Amsterdam, The Hague University of Applied Sciences and Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, in economics, business and computer science.
Most people work in sales, marketing, IT and customer support.

open.text: AOC International (Europe) B.V. and AOC Nederland B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.

growth.text: Founded in 1967; AOC is an own brand of TPV Technology Limited, which it calls the global leader in display manufacturing.
